title: Canonical affine-chart source, normal and integration constructions
statement:
Use the finite coefficient setting $P$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Work with the existing exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], section invariants [def-pur-section-invariant], normal cones [def-pur-normal-bundle], and canonical diagonal data [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data]. Let $d\ge0$, let $h:U\to Y$ be separated of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and smooth of pure relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be of finite type. Put $p:\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. For an etale map $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_Y$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $ep=h$, define the following affine-chart data. The map $m=e\times e$ on self-products is the canonical pullback map, satisfying $m p_A=p_Ue$, and $a:U\times_YU\to(\mathbf A^d_Y\times_Y\mathbf A^d_Y)\times_{\mathbf A^d_Y}U$ is its pullback lift with $p_U$. The lift is etale, separated and quasi-compact and carries the diagonal to the base-changed diagonal. Its ordinary source-section comparison is inverse counit-normalized etale restriction along $a$ followed by inverse smooth section base change, using a presentation $N$ of [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization]; its pro-etale comparison is transported by the canonical source and pullback comparisons of [thm-pur-dnc-invariance].

The diagonal ideal pulls into the diagonal ideal under $m$. Define the deformation map by the extended-Rees map $t\mapsto t$, $f/t\mapsto e^*f/t$. Its zero-fibre compatibility defines the actual normal-cone map by the zero-fibre pullback lift. This map is Cartesian over $e$ and preserves zero sections. Define the normal-section comparison by inverse smooth exceptional section base change for this square, transported through the same site comparisons. The projection, etale-lift, ideal, zero-fibre, Cartesian and zero-section facts just stated are the typing assertions for these constructions.

For every $h$ as above, independently of any choice of $e$, define $b_h$ from the section invariant of its actual normal cone to that of the relative-Spec bundle of its degree-one conormal module, using the canonical homogeneously normalized model of [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data] and counit-normalized section-etale restriction. Define $\beta_h$ by $b_h$ followed by the comparison image of the inverse zero-section integration transpose on that bundle, with its canonical shifted Tate coefficient [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. The bundle orientation is the actual integration construction of [def-pur-finite-ring-section-data, lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation], not an arbitrary orientation. These definitions use any normalized presentation $N$ and apply to arbitrary finite extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, including ramified ones. No conclusion of the affine-chart coherence theorem is assumed. Include $d=0$ and empty schemes.
